description: Adds strategic color to a gray, monochrome or dull interface: semantic good/bad/warning color, accent placement, tinted surfaces and chart colors, with accessible contrast and the brand color leading. Use when the user says a UI or dashboard is grayscale, lifeless or lacks warmth, or users cannot tell good numbers from bad. Not for picking a new palette and fonts from scratch (use ui-ux-pro-max).
